title: Pizza, Pasta, Soup: Who Likes All Three? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
24 kids, three foods, and a question that looks like it needs a big Venn diagram. Vantee shows a much quicker trick: count the kids who say no. You'll also see a second way, why each wrong answer is tempting, and a four-favorites challenge to try yourself.
